Current milestone state — updated 2026-06-09 (evening).

VERSION: v1.1.1 stable. Channels: `rvr` stable (Homebrew seabearDEV/reverie/rvr), `rvr-beta`, `rvr-dev`. Release pipeline healthy (PAT rotation annual, per closed #123).

MILESTONE v1.2.0: ALL SIX ISSUES IMPLEMENTED on PR #129 (branch feat/125-quiet-set-response, one commit per issue), awaiting user review/merge: #125 quiet reverie_set, #124 budget 50→38KB, #126 handshake diet (instructions 8.7→1.9KB + size regression test), #127 projection params (context sizeOnly / --size-only, find keysOnly output projection), #119 WS3 (RVR_SESSION + sessions/<id>.json state file, CLI write-amp + miss-path, aliasResolved fixes), #120 envelope-from-handler-return (+ guard sweep test; caught & fixed result-less data export). Closes the #117 arc. POST-MERGE FOLLOW-UPS: (1) soften "prefer MCP" guidance per [[project.surfaceStrategy]] in CLAUDE.md template + generated docs — deliberately left out of the PR to land after parity actually ships in a release; (2) close #117 umbrella; (3) release cut = v1.2.0.

THEMES BEYOND v1.2.0: soak-gated per [[project.soakPolicy]] — day-7 checkpoint 2026-06-15 (v1.1.1 cycle). Leading candidates: search (#13/#43), entry health (#84). Long-horizon pool unmilestoned: #6 #42 #44 #45 #47 #48 #49 #50 #51 #115 #128 ([[project.platformSupport]]).

NON-ENGINEERING (not issue-tracked): commercial GTM ([[project.commercialContext]]), launch comms, visual identity.
